description.text: Core courses: Typically include Energy System Analysis, Energy Internet Technology, Energy Policy and Regulations, Energy Economics, Smart Grid Technology, Renewable Energy Technology, etc. In addition, it will also involve basic courses such as circuits, modern electronic technology, electromagnetic fields, data structures and algorithms, signals and systems, and automatic control theory.Practical teaching: Relevant practical teaching links will be arranged. Through internships, course design, graduation projects, etc., students will be enabled to apply theoretical knowledge to practice, cultivating their practical and innovative abilities.

duration.text: The Energy Internet Project at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "Admission Application Form for International Students of Xi 'an Jiaotong University" (completed in the online application system of the International Education College of Xi 'an Jiaotong University)A notarized copy of the high school diploma. For texts other than Chinese or English, an official translation notarized copy is required. Fresh graduates should provide the original pre-graduation certificate issued by their current school and supplement the official documents when reporting for enrollment.Academic transcript. Notarized copies of the transcripts of all courses in high school and the explanation of the school's academic performance evaluation system. For texts other than Chinese or English, official translation notarized copies are required. The score report of a unified standardized test in the student's country or an internationally recognized standardized test (such as Atevel, IBDP, etc.)Proof of language proficiency (such as IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, HSK certificates, etc. 2. Native speakers of Chinese/English are not required to provide after being recognized by our school).Five recommendation letters. One letter, issued by the high school principal or teacher (signed by the recommender and indicating the email address and contact number); Study plan. Write in Chinese or English, no less than 600 words; Since the Ordinary valid foreign passport; the foreigners physical check form the original and notarized (this table shall be uniformly printed by the Chinese health and quarantine departments and can click http://sie.xitu.edu.cn/en/2.pdf to download, should be completed in English or Chinese. Applicants should strictly conduct the inspection in accordance with the items required in the table. Forms with missing items, without the applicant's photo attached or without a cross-stitch seal on the photo, and without the doctor's opinion and the hospital's signature and seal are invalid. The validity period of the inspection results is six months. A certificate of no criminal record within the validity period; A certificate of no criminal record within the validity period;Other supporting materials (if any).Note: a. Materials that do not meet the requirements will not be accepted.Items 2 to 10 must all be uploaded to the online registration of the International Education College of Xi 'an Jiaotong University"System;c. All the above materials must be in either Chinese or English. For materials in other languages, translated copies must be providedNotarized copy;d. During the review process, the school may, as needed, require students to submit other materials

requirements.text: Aged 18 to 25, in good health; Holding a valid foreign ordinary passport: High school graduation or above (if not graduated at the time of application, a pre-graduation certificate must be provided, and the high school graduation certificate must be obtained at the latest before enrollment). Meet the corresponding language proficiency requirements.Chinese-taught programs: Proof of Chinese proficiency must be submitted. The Chinese proficiency should be equivalent to HSK level 4 or above. Those whose Chinese proficiency does not meet the standard can choose to study in the preparatory course of Xi 'an Jiaotong University. Only those whose Chinese proficiency reaches level 4 of the International Standard of Chinese Language Proficiency after the preparatory course can enter the undergraduate program. Those who fail to meet the standards are not allowed to enter the professional preparatory course. For details, please visit the official website of the International College at: :/sie.xjtu.edu.cn/. English-taught programs: Submit proof of English proficiency. An IELTS score of 6.0 or a TOEFL score of 80 or a Duolingo score of 110 or above, or other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by our university. Those whose native language is Chinese or English may be exempted from submitting the corresponding language proficiency certificates upon recognition by our school. To apply for the English-taught program in industrial design, an English to TOLC score of no less than 30 points must also be submitted.It complies with the provisions of the Ministry of Education's Document No. 12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education and the relevant regulations of our university
